description: dispatch --dry-run falls through a two-entry chain when the first seat is marked `available = false` in config (a human-flagged outage, checked first and absolutely — accounts.py's `_availability` check 1): outcome becomes chain-fallback, the card names the selected second seat, and a `skipped` line gives the first seat's `unavailable_reason` verbatim. This check is a pure config read — no extra herdr call beyond what a plain chain-primary dry-run already makes (none at all), so the transcript stays empty exactly like dispatch-dry-run-explorer.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.seat-a]
kind = "codex"
short = "sa"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home-a}}"
pool = "codex:a"
available = false
unavailable_reason = "codex quota exhausted"

[accounts.seat-b]
kind = "codex"
short = "sb"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home-b}}"
pool = "codex:b"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[projects.sandbox.chains]
explorer = ["seat-a", "seat-b"]

[roles.explorer]
write_scope = "none"
effort = "low"
on_exhausted = "degrade"
skills = []

[roles.explorer.models]
codex = "gpt-test"
